reason: The memory-bottleneck thesis this book was built on has been confirmed by the tape and the industry data since the 2026-09-21 fill, so there is nothing to reassess and every reason not to pay for churn. Micron closed 2026-09-29 at $1,065 on a 7.17x forward multiple - the book was sized on the claim that bits were the single cheapest bottleneck in the AI buildout at 7-8x forward, and after a 120% YTD run the multiple has not re-rated at all, because earnings are running up as fast as the price. DRAM gross margin printed 84% and is guided to 86%, driven by price rather than volume, and advanced HBM4 capacity is sold out through 2026 under binding contracts. On the NAND side, SanDisk has signed long-term supply agreements with eight customers covering roughly half of expected fiscal-2027 bits, worth $93.9bn at floor pricing - that is exactly the contractual de-risking a commodity-bit book needs, and it is why I am willing to sit through TrendForce's call that NAND price growth moderates to low single digits in Q4 and turns down in H2 2027. The four legs are all within 4% of their fills (MU +0.96, SNDK -3.04, WDC +1.13, LRCX +4.14) and no stop is remotely threatened, so a replacement book would be the same four names at the same 2026-09-30 close, minus two round trips of commissions. The one real argument for acting is that Micron reports fiscal Q4 on 2026-09-30 with options pricing a ~10% move, and I am carrying it at 34%. I am deliberately not trimming into that. The fill is at the close, before the print, so trimming would be paying friction to reduce exposure to a distribution I believe is skewed my way: consensus is $31.73 against $3.03 a year ago, the margin guide is already in hand, and at 7x forward the valuation is not what a sell-the-news break normally requires. A 10% move on a 34% leg is 3.4% of NAV against 14% cash as ballast, which is the volatility this mandate is supposed to accept rather than hedge away. This book is down 7.09% from inception on earlier legs, not on this one; the fix for that is to let a correct thesis run, not to churn it on the eve of its confirmation.
